unique_context: No state education agency guidance on AI in K-12. The Governor's AI & Analytics Center of Excellence working group (launched June 2024) reported in Feb 2025 and Feb 2026 on AI in state government, not schools. A 2025 task-force report recommended AI-literacy curricular frameworks, educator PD, equitable access, student-data protection and district implementation support, but no statewide guidance document has followed.
notes: Trackers (aiforeducation.io, Ballotpedia) list Arkansas as having no released K-12 AI guidance. The 2021 CSforAR high-school AI/ML course standards predate generative AI and are a curriculum standard, not usage guidance.
